reference_normalization_policy.default: N_ref is a fixed bookkeeping count in a comoving volume; n_ref(t)=n_ref0*a(t)^(-3). It is not the evolving actual hydrogen/isotope/baryon count when injection or transmutation occurs.
reference_normalization_policy.source_equation: For physical species density dot(n_s)+3H*n_s=S_s, x_s=n_s/n_ref gives dot(x_s)=S_s/n_ref under the default fixed comoving reference. External injection belongs to S_s and is not absorbed into the reference.
reference_normalization_policy.changing_physical_reference: If a scenario explicitly selects an evolving physical reference, use dot(x_s)=dot(n_s)/n_ref-x_s*dot(n_ref)/n_ref. With dot(n_ref)+3H*n_ref=S_ref this becomes dot(x_s)=(S_s-x_s*S_ref)/n_ref; bind S_ref and its derivative explicitly.
reference_normalization_policy.reference_identity: Record n_ref0,scale-factor normalization,comoving volume convention and selected reference policy in SCENARIO and all consumer bindings.
